## Barbell Standing Behind the Neck Shoulder Press - Spotting Technique

- Stand directly behind the athlete and place hands outside of the athlete's grip (-10)
- Keep hands close to the bar, but not touching it, as the bar ascends and descends (-11)
- If the bar descends too fast, or the athlete becomes offbalanced, assist in keeping the descent and movement slow and controlled (-12)
